notes.title: Patch 1.15
notes.content: [h2]Patchnotes[/h2][p]- Fixed a single 'stuck' spot in front of camp ridge. The ol' put a rock there trick.[/p][p] - Fixed CTD because of pathing in 'Camp Ridge' Scene, though the underlying issue was global. Cheeky little null check fixed everything forever. [/p][p]- Engine version update for Godot from 3.~ to 4.4.[/p][p]- Simplified the occlusion mesh on 'Borros Garden' scene for performance.[/p][p]- Misc typo fixes. [/p][p]- Texture Mipmap bias changed from 0.0 to -2.0, Sharper image quality on nearby textures and less UV bleeding. Hugely impactful to the image quality, in my opinion.[/p]

tags.bug: - Fixed a single 'stuck' spot in front of camp ridge. The ol' put a rock there trick.
- Fixed CTD because of pathing in 'Camp Ridge' Scene, though the underlying issue was global. Cheeky little null check fixed everything forever.

tags.feature: - Engine version update for Godot from 3.~ to 4.4.
- Simplified the occlusion mesh on 'Borros Garden' scene for performance.

tags.balance_change: - Texture Mipmap bias changed from 0.0 to -2.0, Sharper image quality on nearby textures and less UV bleeding. Hugely impactful to the image quality, in my opinion.

notes.title: Patch 1.13
notes.content:
Hi gamers. This is the 13th patch pushed to steam.

[h3]Patchnotes[/h3]
- Fixed cavecrab not dealing damage.
- Gave Tutreetial more roots and a brighter eye (testers kept walking past him, unaware!).
- Fixed a bug allowing the shield to be active while unequipped.
- Lowered the render distance of all static props for performance, plus added some I missed to the list.
- Crates. Crates in the grave. Sorry.
- Minor dialogue changes to help with players missing Tutreetial.
- A few other tiny quality of life changes.


[h3]Soundtrack[/h3]
- The entire Burrow Wing OST is now available on Youtube.
[previewyoutube=tx_lSmW8Y3M;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
